How to Buy the Rolex Submariner SABR Ref. 116659SABR 18k White Gold Without Getting Scammed by Aftermarket Setters

The Ultimate Off-Catalog High-Jewelry Diver

The Rolex Submariner Date SABR Reference 116659SABR in 18k white gold is the ultimate luxury evolution of the world’s most iconic dive watch. Crafted as an off-catalog piece restricted to VIP clients, its name “SABR” represents its fixed bezel encrusted with 36 baguette blue sapphires and 12 baguette diamonds, recreating the first 15-minute countdown scale of a traditional dive bezel using gem-set markers. This is complemented by 92 brilliant-cut diamonds pavé-set across the 18k white gold case lugs and crown guards.

Because an authentic factory 116659SABR commands multi-hundred-thousand-dollar valuations on the private secondary market, it is a primary target for aftermarket setters who modify standard 18k white gold Submariners using commercial-grade diamonds and custom gem bezels.

“SABR-Style” Custom Conversions and Modified Base References

  • What is the problem? Dishonest grey-market dealers take standard white gold Submariners (like Ref. 116619LB “Smurf”), install third-party sapphire/diamond bezels, and drill/pave the lugs to impersonate a factory 116659SABR.
  • Why does it happen? The price delta between a standard white gold Submariner and a genuine factory-set 116659SABR exceeds six figures, offering bad actors enormous financial incentive to market custom builds as authentic factory stock.

The Ref. 116659SABR Authentication Matrix

Before executing a bank wire or signing a private escrow contract for a Rolex Submariner SABR 116659SABR, inspect these key physical attributes:

Inspection Area Factory Original Benchmark Aftermarket / Custom Conversion
Baguette Sapphire & Diamond Bezel 36 blue sapphires and 12 diamonds set with seamless channel alignment; 15-minute scale diamonds match depth and color perfectly. Mismatched sapphire saturation, uneven stone height, loose channel prongs, or visible setting glue under 10x loupe.
Diamond Lug & Guard Pavé 92 factory-set brilliant-cut diamonds across 4 lugs and crown guards set in pristine, perfectly aligned geometric rows. Asymmetrical diamond rows, rough drill edges, or cloudy commercial-grade stones in the pavé bed.
Guarantee Card Reference Serial-matched guarantee card explicitly cites reference code 116659SABR. Guarantee card cites standard models like 116619LB or lacks the SABR gem-setting suffix code.

A 4-Step Secondary Market Buying Protocol

If you are committing six-figure capital to acquire an authentic factory Rolex Submariner SABR, enforce this strict buyer-protection workflow:

  • Step 1: Audit Guarantee Card Reference & Suffix Code: Verify that the original guarantee card explicitly states 116659SABR. Never accept verbal claims of “factory set” if the documentation references a plain ceramic bezel model.
  • Step 2: Mandate Independent Gemological Inspection in Escrow: Send the watch to an accredited vault where a master gemologist inspects the 36 sapphires, 12 bezel diamonds, and 92 case diamonds under 20x magnification to confirm natural origin and factory setting tolerances.
  • Step 3: Inspect 18k White Gold Hallmarks & Glidelock Clasp: Verify the St. Bernard dog head, 750 gold scales, and Rolex Crown hallmarks stamped under the lugs and inside the Glidelock clasp for deep, razor-sharp outlines without buffed edges.
  • Step 4: Check Calibre 3135 Movement & Case Serial Cross-Check: Confirm the automatic movement operates within Superlative Chronometer parameters (-2/+2 sec/day) and case serials match official Rolex archival logs.

Final Verdict

The Rolex Submariner SABR Ref. 116659SABR in 18k White Gold is an exceptional blend of iconic sports watch geometry and high-jewelry gem setting. By demanding explicit guarantee card suffix matching, inspecting sapphire channel settings under high magnification, and securing independent escrow authentication, you protect your capital and acquire a true factory masterpiece.
